results: 1. adduction in horizontal gaze (each eye): limited adduction of the RIGHT eye that fails to cross the midline, with abducting nystagmus of the left eye on left gaze - mimics an INO
2. MRI sella and orbits: subtle MEDIAL ORBITAL WALL FRACTURE with medial rectus involvement; no brainstem pathology
3. CT head (non-contrast): multiple skull fractures and epidural haemorrhage; NO evidence of brainstem injury
4. forced duction test: restriction consistent with a mechanical cause
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Traumatic pseudo-internuclear ophthalmoplegia caused by mechanical entrapment/restriction of the right medial rectus in a medial orbital wall (“blowout”) fracture

ALTERNATIVE: True internuclear ophthalmoplegia from medial longitudinal fasciculus injury

ALTERNATIVE: Traumatic right medial rectus muscle palsy or direct muscle injury

ALTERNATIVE: Traumatic orbital apex or cranial nerve injury causing binocular diplopia
dx: Traumatic pseudo-internuclear ophthalmoplegia caused by mechanical entrapment/restriction of the right medial rectus in a medial orbital wall (“blowout”) fracture
